title: Canadian Poutine Casserole
description: A twist on the classic Canadian comfort food, this casserole combines the crispy fries and squeaky cheese curds with a yeasty, fluffy twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yeast and warm water. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
Add flour, salt, and sugar to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
After the dough has risen, punch it down and roll it out into a rectangle.
Spread the crushed french fries evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the diced vegetables, cheese curds, and poutine gravy mix over the fries.
Roll the dough into a tight log, starting from the long side.
Cut the log into 1-inch thick slices and place them in a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
